result.description: High-efficiency redundant hot-swap power supply unit designed for 2U rack servers and network appliances. Delivers 1440 watts continuous output with 80 Plus Titanium efficiency, wide-range 100-240V input, active power factor correction, and low-noise fan control for datacenter use. Includes over-current, over-voltage, short-circuit, and over-temperature protections.
result.title: Aurora 1440W Titanium Server PSU
